notes: ACCESS: robots.txt (https://www.westwing.co.uk/robots.txt) checked first - User-agent:* disallows /c/*, /products/*, /collections/*, /api/*, /customer*, /sso/*, /p/s/*, *--*, /all-products; the anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web section carries the identical disallow list (no full-site block). All URLs used in this extraction are plain top-level vanity slugs (e.g. /bedding/, /storage/, /rugs/) which are NOT covered by any Disallow rule, so tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (curl with a Chrome UA) was used exclusively for the whole run - pages are server-rendered with full product-count text and a subcategory strip, no Playwright/Chrome escalation was needed. TREE: built as the union of sitemap-categories.xml (fetched via curl; 562 category URLs) and each visited page's own rendered subcategory strip (grep'd nav links out of the HTML); h1/title tag checked against the requested slug on every leaf. Confirmed h1/title matched on all recorded rows. Site is Shopify-based and publishes near-duplicate URL/slug pairs for the same product type reached via two different mega-menu branches (e.g. /wardrobes/ under Furniture vs /wardrobes-2/ under Storage; /kitchen-storage/ under Kitchen vs /kitchen-storage-3/ under Storage; /baskets/ vs /baskets-2/; /laundry-baskets/ vs /laundry-baskets-3/; /sofa-cushions/ vs /sofa-cushions-2/) - for each such pair only one instance was kept (the one reached via the semantically-matching hub, or the Storage/Textile-hub instance when both existed) to avoid duplicate-looking rows; the discarded twin is noted per-row below. QTY: taken from the rendered '<N> products are displayed' pagination-total text at the bottom of each category grid (cross-checked against the '<N> products' header badge at the top of the page - both matched on every page sampled). TEXTILE TREE: /textiles/ hub -> Bedding (bedspreads, duvet-covers, duvets, fitted-sheets, flat-sheets, pillowcases, pillows), Blankets & Throws, Curtains & Drapes, Decorative Cushions (cosy/fall/patterned/plain cushions, cushion inserts, outdoor cushions), Seat Cushions, Sofa Cushions, Outdoor Seat Cushions, Spring/Summer seasonal cushions, Bathroom Textiles (bath mats, beach & hammam towels, towels), Shower Curtains, Bathrobes, Kitchen Textiles & Table Linen (kitchen textiles, napkins, placemats, table runners, tablecloths), Rugs (cotton/natural-fibre/synthetic-fibre/wool/organic/round/rectangular rugs, rug runners, outdoor rugs, doormats, kids rugs), Kids Textiles (kids bed linen, cuddly pillows, gauze & muslin cloths, playmats & crawling blankets), and 5 standalone Christmas seasonal textile pages (table linen, textiles, cushions, bedding, blankets & throws) found only via the sitemap (not linked from the Textiles hub's own subnav, but genuine standalone listing pages with real counts, not View-All/collection pages). EXCLUDED from Textile: the Kitchen&Dining-hub duplicate of table linen (/table-linen/ with siblings coasters/tableware/napkin-holders, and its -2 suffixed children napkins-2/placemats-2/table-runners-2/tablecloths-2) - kept only the Textiles-hub version; /napkin-holders/ (holder hardware, not textile); /floor-cushions-pouffes/ (mixed listing that bundles textile floor cushions with Furniture pouffes/ottomans on one URL, cannot be split, excluded per Furniture-boundary caution); /anti-slip-underlays/ (rug-pad hardware, not itself a floor textile, analogous to excluded curtain-rod hardware); baby-nest-sleeping-bags (apparel-adjacent infant sleep gear) and changing-mats (non-fabric changing pad) under Kids Textiles; all Furniture, Kitchen & Dining crockery/serveware, Garden furniture, and Baby-gear (bouncers, high chairs, cots) nodes encountered in sub-nav strips. STORAGE TREE: the site's actual /storage/ nav hub -> Cabinets (bathroom cabinets, bedside tables, display cabinets, drawer units, dressers, highboards, sideboards, TV stands), Racks & Stands (coat hooks & rails, coat racks & stands, open wardrobes, shoe storage), Shelves (bathroom shelves, kids shelves, shelving units, wall shelves), Wardrobes (corner/hinged-door/modular/sliding-door wardrobes), Small Storage & Organisers (baskets, bathroom accessories, bins, jewellery boxes, kitchen storage, laundry baskets, office storage, storage boxes) - all explicitly placed under the Storage hub per storage.md S21's 'website hierarchy decides' rule for ambiguous furniture-type storage items (cabinets/dressers/sideboards/TV stands/wardrobes/shelves). Also recorded as separate hubs/flat rows not reachable from the /storage/ hub itself but independently storage-qualifying per rule text regardless of which mega-menu branch hosts them: Kids Storage (changing table storage, baskets & boxes, hooks & wall storage) found under the Kids nav section; Food Storage Containers, Sink Organisers, Wine Racks, Bread Baskets & Bread Bins found under the Kitchen nav section; Bathroom Storage and Towel Racks found under the Bathroom/accessories nav section; Garden Storage and Outdoor Storage (2 products each); Christmas Storage (0 products, explicit zero-count page, kept per storage.md S39). EXCLUDED from Storage: /furniture-with-storage-function/ and its children Beds with Storage, Benches, Coffee Tables, Pouffes with Storage - even though filed under the Storage nav hub, storage.md S27 explicitly names Bed/Coffee Table/Sofa/Bench-type seating as Furniture regardless of a storage feature; the plain (non -2/-3) Furniture-hub duplicates of Cabinets/Wardrobes/Shelves/Racks & Stands and their children (drawer-units, corner-wardrobes, shoe-cupboards-shoe-racks, bathroom-shelves, shelving-units, wall-shelves, coat-hooks-rails, coat-racks-stands, open-wardrobes, etc., all reached via /furniture/'s own subnav) - kept only the Storage-hub instance of each duplicate pair; kitchen-rubbish-bins (waste bin, not organizational storage); plain /kitchen-storage/, /baskets/, /laundry-baskets/ (Kitchen/Bathroom-hub duplicates of kitchen-storage-3/baskets-2/laundry-baskets-3, identical product counts confirming same underlying collection). LOW/MEDIUM confidence flags: Bathroom Accessories (generic name, could include non-storage items, kept because explicitly filed under the Storage-hub's Small Storage & Organisers branch); Wine Racks and Bread Baskets & Bread Bins (storage.md does not name these explicitly, judged Storage by primary organizing/holding function).
